title: Information Systems — Flight Deck — Install the Ventilated Flight Bag Arm and the Switched Power Supply

ata.title: Flight Deck Information — Electronic Flight Bag Unit

abstract: Replaces the flight deck electronic flight bag mounting arm with a ventilated item that holds the unit clear of the sun line, and fits a supply that removes display power during a ground power turnaround.

sections.planning_reason: Fifty-one thermal shutdowns of the captain side electronic flight bag were reported over two summer seasons, all from operators based below forty degrees latitude and all from the left hand installation. The unit sits close to the windscreen on an arm designed for a lighter display and with no rear clearance, and it stays powered whenever the aircraft has ground power. The result is that the captain calculates take-off performance on a hand-held device, which several flight operations departments will not accept.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to replace the mounting arm on each side with a ventilated arm that holds the unit 60 mm further aft and 25 mm lower, to reposition the control panel on the new arm, and to replace the power supply module with a switched unit that removes display power when the aircraft is on ground power and no crew member is logged in. The connector assembly is renewed to carry the additional discrete and the unit harness is extended and re-clamped. The unit itself, its software and its data loading path are unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Remove electrical power and remove the side console trim on the side being worked. Remove the electronic flight bag unit and set it aside. Remove the existing mounting arm and the control panel. Install the ventilated arm on the console base, using the new bolt pattern, and reposition the control panel. Replace the power supply module and the connector assembly. Extend the unit harness and re-clamp it at the intervals given in the installation drawing. Reinstall the unit on the new arm using AMM-T-46-20-11-400-004-A and confirm the clearance to the windscreen and to the sidestick full travel. Restore power. Do the flight bag functional test and confirm that the display removes power on ground power with no crew logged in, and restores it on log-in. Refit the console trim. Repeat on the other side if both are being converted. Record the modification.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to TITAN-88 aircraft in the MSN T00069 to T00224 range, excluding MSN T00145 which carries a non-standard console. Operators may embody the left hand side only, and many will, because the right hand installation has never reported the condition. A mixed installation is explicitly permitted.
sections.material_note: Kit K4620-1005-01 covers one side. Order two kits for a full flight deck. The ventilated arm is a twelve week lead item. Removed arms are scrapped locally. The switched power supply is common to both sides.

type_data.compliance_time: At the operator's convenience. Operators reporting thermal shutdowns are advised to embody before the next summer season.
